audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is called matchup-defining across the full layer and the only advice attached to it is "Don't get caged" and "Dodge or sidestep it". Nothing anywhere says the wall is destructible.
audit.why: Riot's text: "Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement." Breaking a segment is the counterplay, and it is a counterplay Nasus is unusually good at because he is an auto-attacker standing right next to it. Framing the cage as something you either dodge or lose to teaches a Nasus to stand inside it and die instead of hitting the wall. "Dodge or sidestep it" is also wrong on its face — it is a ground-targeted wall, not a skillshot.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession is a destructible wall on 20s at rank 1 — if you are caged, attack a segment and walk out rather than waiting it out.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (Riot Data Dragon 16.15.1) — W description and cooldown "20/18/16/14/12"

audit.whatIsWrong: The "dodge or sidestep" instruction is attached to Dark Procession, while Mourning Mist — the ability that actually is a dodgeable skillshot — is described only as something that happens to you.
audit.why: Mourning Mist is a thrown globule at 700 range carrying the projectile flag. It is the one ability in Yorick's kit that can be sidestepped, and it is also the one that starts everything: it marks the target and his summoned units gain move speed moving toward marked targets. The advice is attached to exactly the wrong ability in both directions.
audit.corrected: Mourning Mist is the skillshot — a thrown globule at 700 range on 12s at rank 1. Sidestep that, and the swarm has nothing to run at.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json — E description, flags = {projectile, slow}, cooldown "12/11/10/9/8"

audit.whatIsWrong: Mourning Mist's armor reduction is never mentioned in either layer, though its slow and its marking are.
audit.why: Riot's text: "throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies." The recommended build in report[8].t is armour-heavy — Plated Steelcaps and Frozen Heart. Yorick shreds that armour on a 12-second cooldown before the ghouls arrive, so the defensive value of the build is lower in the exact moment it is being tested. A reader who knows the mist slows but not that it shreds will misjudge how much the swarm actually hurts.
audit.corrected: Mourning Mist reduces your armor as well as slowing and marking you, so the swarm that follows hits harder than the raw numbers suggest.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds is never mentioned despite Last Rites healing on one of the shortest cooldowns in the matchup.
audit.why: Last Rites heals Yorick and runs 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 — by rank 5 that is a heal every four seconds, layered under a ghoul pack that is doing the damage for him. The matchup plan on both sides is an attrition grind ("my lifesteal eats the ghoul DPS"), and an attrition plan against a 4-second heal without anti-heal is the losing half of that trade.
audit.corrected: Last Rites heals him every 6s at rank 1, falling to 4s — bring Grievous Wounds before committing to any grind.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number appears anywhere in either layer, including for the ability the full layer calls matchup-defining.
audit.why: The three numbers that shape this lane are Dark Procession at 20s rank 1, Mourning Mist at 12s rank 1, and Eulogy of the Isles at 160/130/100 — a 160-second ultimate at rank 1, which is a very long time to be without a Maiden and the clearest window in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession 20s at rank 1. Mourning Mist 12s at rank 1. Eulogy of the Isles 160s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer rates this HARD at 7/10 difficulty with Yorick taking five of seven phases, for a lane that runs 50.43% over 694 games.
audit.why: 50.43% over a 694-game sample is as close to a coin flip as this dataset gets. The content layer reflects that honestly — four Skill stages, two Yorick, one Nasus — while the full layer reads as a losing matchup. Not submitted as an edit: the ±10% band cannot turn "Yorick" into "Skill", and I do not know the permitted values for diff beyond seeing HARD and EVEN in use.
audit.corrected: The content-layer chart is the accurate one. full.diff and phases[0..4].side oversell Yorick relative to a 50.43% result.
sources: packet winRate 50.43 / 694 games; champ-data/content/nasus.js win[], champ-data/nasus.full.js phases[].side and diff

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet suspectNames flags "Spirit Fire's" in wants.you[0] as a probable wrong ability name.
audit.why: False positive from the possessive. Spirit Fire is correct, and the surrounding advice — clear ghouls with its AoE rather than trading — is the right read for the matchup and left unchanged.

notes: This was the best-written entry in my slice — the content layer already names Mourning Mist, Maiden of the Mist and Dark Procession correctly and reads the swarm dynamic right, so it needed fewer corrections than the others. The one real gap is that nothing anywhere said Dark Procession is destructible, while the full layer simultaneously calls it matchup-defining and tells the reader to 'dodge or sidestep it' — which is impossible for a ground-targeted wall and would leave a caged Nasus standing still. I also moved the sidestep instruction onto Mourning Mist, which actually is a projectile. Note that this entry is written in first person ('I soak Q farm') while every other Nasus entry I audited is second person; I preserved the voice rather than spend the length budget on it, but it is a consistency issue worth a pass. full.diff = HARD at 7/10 for a 50.43% / 694-game lane is the widest rating-to-data gap I found in this slice.
